verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to act on many applications, marks or records at once, such as bulk filing, bulk status updates, bulk payments or batch API jobs. Patent Center's multi-file drag-and-drop only attaches several documents to a single submission, which is related but not a bulk operation across items. The API endpoint shows machine access exists but documents no bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
